# LoopX for DSH > 为 DSH 接入 LoopX 同会话续轮与 GoalBar。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[loopx-project/loopx](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx) - **版本号**：0.1.1-beta.6（[固定提交 ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/tree/ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-01（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源码支持精确激活、唯一绑定、quota/heartbeat 校验和暂停边界；未运行宿主、CLI 或模型。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：已有 LoopX 目标且希望在同一 DSH 会话持续推进的用户；原办法为人工查询 heartbeat 并复制任务。[Q01](#research-q01) - **亮点**：把 LoopX 权威准入接到 DSH 会话和 GoalBar，不把整仓目标引擎归于桥接包。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) - **思考**：Pause 撤销待处理工作，但保留已 claimed/admitted 预约；界面停止状态不能证明当前轮或外部副作用停止。[Q03](#research-q03) - **建议**：未验证假设：在 Pause 后明确显示剩余当前轮与已撤销的预约，可能减少用户误判；须对照已有 UI 验证延迟和错误。[Q05](#research-q05) 采用建议：以独立项目核验绑定与 quota，用非敏感任务试验暂停前后状态；异常时检查当前轮并回退手工。[Q04](#research-q04) ## 核心贡献 把 LoopX 权威准入接到 DSH 会话和 GoalBar，不把整仓目标引擎归于桥接包。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) ## 关键质疑 Pause 撤销待处理工作，但保留已 claimed/admitted 预约；界面停止状态不能证明当前轮或外部副作用停止。[Q03](#research-q03) ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 未验证假设：在 Pause 后明确显示剩余当前轮与已撤销的预约，可能减少用户误判；须对照已有 UI 验证延迟和错误。[Q05](#research-q05) 固定 DSH 和 LoopX 版本，隔离项目检验匹配失败、quota、重试、人工竞争及 Pause 后当前轮。 ## 场景与替代办法 已有 LoopX 目标且希望在同一 DSH 会话持续推进的用户；原办法为人工查询 heartbeat 并复制任务。[Q01](#research-q01) 人工查 quota 和 heartbeat、将下一步粘贴进会话；更费操作但容易逐轮检查。 [Q01](#research-q01) ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 兼容 DSH 宿主 | 必需 | 会话与 UI | 无法接入 | | LoopX CLI 及 Python | 初始化与续轮必需 | 权威状态及技能 | 初始化失败 | | 唯一绑定与 quota | 自动续轮必需 | 目标与 Agent 准入 | 不继续 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 初始化 | 安装 CLI 和技能 | 核对 CommandResult | | 激活 | 当前 Session 调用 LoopX skill | 核对唯一绑定 | | 继续 | 核对 quota 和每轮结果 | Pause 后仍检查当前轮 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 安装与模型调用 | 环境及绑定配置 | 初始化可能产生两个模型 followup | | 持续 | 模型与工具费用未知 | 检查每轮结果 | 质量及节约未测 | | 恢复 | 当前轮及外部调用可能继续 | 人工核查与处置 | Pause 非回滚 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 会话准入 | typed 激活与唯一绑定 | 跨系统恰好一次 | | 操作可见性 | GoalBar 和 Pause 机制 | 用户理解和实际效果 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：DSH 插件如何将 LoopX 的权威目标接入同会话续轮，其暂停和成本边界是什么？ ### Q01 · 谁需要该插件，目标状态由谁管理？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 该组件服务于已使用 LoopX 长期目标、希望在同一 DSH 会话自动继续任务的用户。人工替代是查 quota 和 heartbeat、手动贴入会话；插件连接 GoalBar、显式激活和 Driver。Goal、Todo、quota、线程绑定仍由 LoopX 所有，包是桥接，不能将整个 LoopX 引擎归于插件。安装不等于激活，自动续轮也不证明任务产物正确。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/cordis.patch.yml:1-16](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/blob/ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2/packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/cordis.patch.yml#L1-L16) 分别挂载 GoalBar、初始化、Driver 和默认关闭 observer。
查看原文（16行） ```text # LoopX owns Goal, Todo, quota, and thread-binding authority. - insert: # The package-root Host row is also the discovery anchor for dsh.client. - id: loopx-goalbar name: dsh-loopx-plugin - id: loopx-init-command name: dsh-loopx-plugin/init-command - id: loopx-driver name: dsh-loopx-plugin/driver # Loaded as its own default-off Cordis row. It has no Driver or Agent # injection and registers only session publication hooks when fully pinned. - id: loopx-shadow-observer name: dsh-loopx-plugin/observer ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/README.md:482-507](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/blob/ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2/packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/README.md#L482-L507) 按 Session 的激活条件和权威边界。
查看原文（26行） ```text ## Driver activation boundary Activation is per Session, not per plugin, process, Agent, Goal, or project. The Driver accepts only either of these durable typed Session facts: - a `user/message` whose source is exactly `skill-invocation`, whose name is exactly `loopx`, and whose form is exactly `instructions`; - a model `tool/call` named exactly `skill`, with JSON object arguments whose `name` is exactly `loopx`, paired by call id with a subsequent successful `tool/result`. A skill catalog, ordinary prose, shell text, `/loopx-init`, plugin-authored init or heartbeat messages, a failed, malformed, unmatched, or superseded model call, and the presence of a CLI, registry, Goal, binding, or project file do not activate the Driver. Recovery folds only the current Session's existing typed event history in memory and performs no external probe. Replacing or clearing a Session recomputes from the replacement history; activation never inherits across that boundary and has no plugin-owned durable store. Existing Sessions upgraded from an older plugin version remain inactive when their retained history has no recognizable invocation evidence. Invoke the installed `loopx` skill once in every Session that should continue automatically. Activation records intent only: it does not create a binding, select a Goal or Agent, spend quota, or grant tool authority. After activation, the existing exact binding, fresh quota, scheduler/heartbeat, reservation, and pre-step revalidation order remains authoritative. ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/index.ts:10-26](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/blob/ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2/packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/index.ts#L10-L26) Host 挂载 GoalBar 服务。
查看原文（17行） ```text export const name = 'dsh-loopx-plugin' export const inject = ['agents', 'connection', 'loopxBootstrap'] /** Package-root Host plugin: one GoalBar service, never a second Driver. */ export function apply(ctx: Context): void { ctx.effect(() => { const service = createGoalBarService({ getAgent: sessionId => ctx.agents.get(sessionId as Agent['id']), coordinator: goalBarCoordinator, resolveCommand: signal => resolvePluginLoopXCommand({ signal }), warn: message => { ctx.logger.warn(message) }, }) const disposeRpc = registerGoalBarConnectionTransport(ctx.connection, service) return async () => { await service.dispose() await disposeRpc() } ```
#### 缺口 - 固定版本的 DSH 宿主、LoopX CLI 和模型未在本轮运行 **影响**：不能据静态接线证明实际续轮、任务质量或工具副作用 **进一步探讨**：隔离工作区验证绑定、quota、暂停和任务产物 ### Q02 · Driver 如何确认激活、绑定与续轮？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 Driver 只接受精确的用户 skill-invocation 或匹配成功结果的模型 skill 调用；普通文本和初始化不算激活。它要求 binding 为当前线程且恰好一个 Goal/Agent，检查 quota 的身份和 turn_instance_id 回执，heartbeat 也必须有同一目标、Agent、turn id 与唯一任务标记。然后处理预约和宿主监听器前后重查；这些是静态准入机制，非跨进程及外部业务效果的原子性证明。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/driver.ts:216-237](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/blob/ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2/packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/driver.ts#L216-L237) 识别精确用户或模型调用。
查看原文（22行） ```text function exactUserActivation(event: SessionEvent): boolean { if (event.type !== 'user/message') return false const data = record(event.data) const source = record(data?.source) return source?.kind === 'skill-invocation' && source.name === 'loopx' && source.form === 'instructions' } function exactModelActivationCall(event: SessionEvent): string | undefined { if (event.type !== 'tool/call') return undefined const data = record(event.data) const callId = eventCallId(data?.callId) if (callId === undefined || data?.name !== 'skill' || typeof data.arguments !== 'string') return undefined let parsed: unknown try { parsed = JSON.parse(data.arguments) } catch { return undefined } return record(parsed)?.name === 'loopx' ? callId : undefined ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/driver.ts:240-278](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/blob/ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2/packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/driver.ts#L240-L278) 模型调用需匹配成功结果。
查看原文（39行） ```text function foldActivationEvent( projection: ActivationProjection, event: SessionEvent, ): void { if (projection.activated) return if (exactUserActivation(event)) { projection.activated = true projection.pendingModelCalls.clear() return } if (event.type === 'tool/call') { const data = record(event.data) const callId = eventCallId(data?.callId) if (callId === undefined) return projection.pendingModelCalls.delete(callId) if (exactModelActivationCall(event) !== undefined) { projection.pendingModelCalls.add(callId) } return } if (event.type !== 'tool/result') return const data = record(event.data) const message = record(data?.message) const source = record(message?.source) const callId = eventCallId(source?.callId) if (callId === undefined) return const matched = projection.pendingModelCalls.delete(callId) const content = message?.content const block = Array.isArray(content) && content.length === 1 ? record(content[0]) : undefined const successful = source?.kind === 'tool' && message?.role === 'user' && block?.type === 'tool-result' && block.toolCallId === callId && (block.isError === undefined || block.isError === false) && data?.error === undefined if (matched && successful) { projection.activated = true ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/driver.ts:306-355](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/blob/ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2/packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/driver.ts#L306-L355) 唯一绑定与 quota 回执校验。
查看原文（50行） ```text function exactBinding( payload: Record, threadId: string, ): Binding | undefined { if (payload.schema_version !== RESOLUTION_SCHEMA || payload.ok !== true || payload.status !== 'bound' || payload.host_surface !== HOST_SURFACE || payload.thread_id !== threadId) return undefined const goalId = typeof payload.goal_id === 'string' ? payload.goal_id : '' const agentId = typeof payload.agent_id === 'string' ? payload.agent_id : '' const matches = Array.isArray(payload.matches) ? payload.matches : [] const match = matches.length === 1 ? record(matches[0]) : undefined return goalId.length > 0 && goalId.trim() === goalId && agentId.length > 0 && agentId.trim() === agentId && match?.goal_id === goalId && match.agent_id === agentId ? { goalId, agentId } : undefined } function exactQuotaContext( payload: Record, binding: Binding, ): boolean { const identity = record(payload.agent_identity) return payload.mode === 'should-run' && payload.goal_id === binding.goalId && identity?.agent_id === binding.agentId && identity.registered === true } function exactQuotaReceipt( payload: Record, turnInstanceId: string, ): boolean { return record(payload.heartbeat_receipt)?.turn_instance_id === turnInstanceId } function exactQuota( payload: Record, binding: Binding, turnInstanceId: string, ): boolean { return exactQuotaContext(payload, binding) && payload.ok === true && payload.should_run === true && exactQuotaReceipt(payload, turnInstanceId) ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/driver.ts:405-423](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/blob/ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2/packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/driver.ts#L405-L423) heartbeat 身份与任务标记校验。
查看原文（19行） ```text function exactHeartbeat( payload: Record, binding: Binding, turnInstanceId: string, ): string | undefined { if (payload.schema_version !== HEARTBEAT_SCHEMA || payload.ok !== true || payload.goal_id !== binding.goalId || payload.agent_id !== binding.agentId || payload.turn_instance_id !== turnInstanceId) return undefined const taskBody = typeof payload.task_body === 'string' ? payload.task_body : '' const assignments = [...taskBody.matchAll(/\bLOOPX_TURN=([^\s`'";]+)/gu)] .map(match => match[1]) return taskBody.length > 0 && taskBody.length <= 32_000 && assignments.length === 1 && assignments[0] === turnInstanceId ? taskBody : undefined ```
**依据 5 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/README.md:533-539](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/blob/ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2/packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/README.md#L533-L539) 绑定和 pre-step 重查及人工优先。 ```text The Driver resolves the current project registry with `resolve-agent-thread`, requires one exact Goal/Agent match for the live DSH session, and rechecks binding plus quota before and after downstream pre-step listeners. A human message removes an unclaimed automatic reservation; a mixed batch rejects the automatic message and restores the human work. The Driver queues at most one Driver-owned followup per automatic admission. Initialization messages use the distinct `dsh-loopx-plugin/init-command` ``` #### 缺口 - 固定版本的 DSH 宿主、LoopX CLI 和模型未在本轮运行 **影响**：不能据静态接线证明实际续轮、任务质量或工具副作用 **进一步探讨**：隔离工作区验证绑定、quota、暂停和任务产物 ### Q03 · Pause 是否停止已经开始的工作？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 Driver 的 cancelQueued 对已 claimed 或 admitted 的预约设置 preserveAcrossPause，然后取消待处理工作；因此 Pause 不等于取消已经认领或正在执行的模型轮次，更不能回滚外部工具动作。人类消息会标记竞争并取消待处理续轮；错误暂停本次自动评估，人工消息可清除该标记。现场应监测当前轮和副作用，不以按钮状态推断全部工作已经停止。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/driver.ts:533-560](https://github.com/loopx-project/loopx/blob/ec91c4dbbb9aecf0abd0395455fc52466506f2b2/packages/dsh-loopx-plugin/src/driver.ts#L533-L560) 人工消息与错误影响待处理续轮。
